Execution Copy ZONINGLOT DEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT ("Agreement") made as of this 30th day of October, 2014 by and between AVENUE M REALTY HOLDINGS LLC, a New York limited liability company with an office at c/o Jeffrey Zwick & Associates, PC, 266 Broadway, Suite 403, Brooklyn, New York 11211 ("Owner") and OHEL CHILDREN'S HOME AND FAMILY SERVICES, INC., a New York not-for-profit corporation, having an address at 4510 16TH Avenue,Brooklyn,NewYork 11223("Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner in fee of a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Kings, City, County and State of New York, known as and by a portion of Tax Lot 35[Tentative Tax Lot 40] in Block 6733on the Tax Map of theCityofNewYork,andbythestreetaddressof 1301-1323AvenueM,Brooklyn,New York, and more particularly described on Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein called the “Owner Land,” said building and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof as permitted hereunder, being hereinafter referred to as the “Owner Building,”and the Owner Land and the OwnerBuilding beinghereinafter collectively referred to as the“Owner Premises"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner in fee of a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Kings, City, County and State of New York,known as a portion of TaxLot 35[Tentative TaxLot 35] inBlock 6733on theTaxMap of the City of NewYork, and by the street address of 1301-1323 Avenue M, Brooklyn, New York, and more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein called the “Developer Land,” and said building and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof as permitted hereunder, being hereinafter referred to as the “Developer Building,”and the Developer Land being herein called the“Developer Premises"); WHEREAS, prior to the sale of the Developer Premises to Developer pursuant to a Contract of Sale and Purchase Agreement dated October 30, 2014 (the “Purchase and Sale Agreement"), the Owner Land and the Developer Land (collectively, the “Land") composed a single tax lot in single ownership and the Developer Building and the Owner Building composed a single building with a single Certificate of Occupancy; WHEREAS, pursuant to the Purchase and Sale Agreement, Owner sold the Developer "community facility”" (as defined in $12-10 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York ("Zoning Resolution"or “ZR"); WHEREAS,in order tofacilitatethesaleof theDeveloperPremises toDeveloper,the Premises will be subdivided into two tax lots composed of the Owner Land and the Developer Land, and the existing building at the Premises will be subdivided into the Owner Building and the Developer Building;
